;Disasters and accidents
*The flooding of the [[Citarum River]], [[Indonesia]], causes at least two deaths. [https://www.thejakartapost.com/news/2019/03/07/thousands-surrounded-by-floods-across-java.html (''The Jakarta Post'')]

;Arts and culture
*[[Weinstein effect]]
**Celebrity chef [[Mario Batali]] gives up his stake in his restaurants more than a year after being accused of sexual misconduct. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/mar/06/mario-batali-restaurants-give-up-sexual-assault-allegations (''The Guardian'')]
* [[Alex Trebek]], host of the American [[Broadcast syndication|syndicated]] game show ''[[Jeopardy!]]'' since 1984, announces that he has been diagnosed with terminal stage 4 [[pancreatic cancer]]. He plans to continue hosting during his treatment. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/03/06/entertainment/alex-trebek-pancreatic-cancer/index.html (CNN)]

;Business and economy
*The [[United States Department of Commerce|United States Commerce Department]] reports the country's 2018 trade deficit was $621 billion (£472.5 bn), the highest since 2008. [https://www.bbc.com/news/business-47472282 (BBC News)]
*[[Economy of the United States]]
**Production ends at [[General Motors]]' [[Lordstown Assembly]] complex in [[Lordstown, Ohio]], United States. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/03/04/business/general-motors-lordstown/index.html (CNN)]
**[[Dollar Tree]] announces it will close 390 [[Family Dollar]] stores, and rebrand a further 200 Family Dollar stores as Dollar Tree. [https://www.cnbc.com/2019/03/06/dollar-tree-to-close-up-to-390-family-dollar-stores-this-year.html (CNBC)]

;Law and crime
* [[2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis]], [[Corruption in Venezuela]], [[Censorship in Venezuela]]
**Venezuelan journalist [[Alí Domínguez]], who disappeared a week ago, dies from injuries of beating and torture. [http://www.eluniversal.com/sucesos/34886/asesinado-activista-ali-dominguez (''El Universal'')], [https://video.foxbusiness.com/v/6011377812001 (Fox News)]
*[[China–United States trade war]]
**[[Huawei]] sues the [[Federal government of the United States|U.S. Government]] to challenge the constitutionality of ''Section 889'' of the [[National Defense Authorization Act]] which prohibits U.S. executive government agencies from procuring telecommunications equipment from two [[China|Chinese]] companies, Huawei and [[ZTE]]. [https://www.cnbc.com/2019/03/07/huawei-sues-the-us-over-ban-preventing-it-from-selling-its-equipment.html (CNBC)]

;Sports
* [[2018–19 UEFA Champions League]]
** [[Manchester United F.C.|Manchester United]] defeats [[Paris Saint-Germain F.C.|Paris Saint-Germain]] 3–1 [[Parc des Princes|in Paris]], overcoming a 2–0 [[Old Trafford|home-leg]] deficit to advance to the [[2018–19 UEFA Champions League#Quarter-finals|quarter-finals]] with a 3–3 win on [[Away goals rule|away goals]]. United becomes the first side in the history of the Champions League or European Cup to overcome a first-leg home deficit of 2–0 or greater in a knockout tie. [https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/47461886 (BBC Sport)]
